summary: Secondary state-machine transition handler. Guards on the new state a2 being valid and different from the last state stored at this[10]. Dispatches a2 (0-4) via a jump table to set the mode sub-fields this[6]/this[7]/this[8] (offsets 0x18/0x1C/0x20) to small integer modes, skipping a write when the field already holds the target value, and notifying the device object at dword_8B89A0 through vtable offset +252. Stores a2 back into this[10] at the end.

operations.description: Guard on the transition: skip entirely when a2 == -1 or a2 equals the last stored state this[10].
Dispatch on a2 through the jump table jpt_554314 over cases 0-4.
Cases 0 and 1 set this[6] (offset 0x18) to 2, guarded by guard:0; case 2 sets it to 4, guarded by guard:1.
Notify the device object dword_8B89A0 via vtable offset +252 with mode 4 when this[6] changes.
Case 0 sets this[7] (offset 0x1C) to 2 (guard:2); case 1 sets it to 1 (guard:3); case 2 sets it to 2 (guard:2); when it changes, the value flows to the vtable +252 notification as the payload.
Case 2 sets this[8] (offset 0x20) to 1, guarded by guard:4, and notifies with mode 6.
Cases 3 and 4 route through EnumToFieldOffsetSetter on this+1 instead of direct field writes, then notify through vtable +252 when it reports a change.
Persist the accepted transition: this[10] (offset 0x28) = a2.
Invoked by MultiFieldSetterDispatchingTo7SubSetters (0x005546A0) as one of several sub-state setters.

unresolved: Enum values written to this[6]/this[7]/this[8] (2, 4, 1) and the notify modes (4, 5, 6) have no packet-grounded meaning; the state-machine role is inferred from the field-change guard pattern.
The _DWORD*-24 / -28 / -32 self-pointer comparisons are decompiler artifacts and their runtime meaning is unknown.
